versions.subject: Merge PR #5772 from @swachchhanda000 - Add Shai-Hulud: The Second Coming Rules
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
       # Add more script interpreters as needed
        - '\node.exe'
        - '\bun.exe'
selection_child:
    - Image|endswith:
          - 'trufflehog.exe'
          - 'gitleaks.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains:
          - 'trufflehog'
          - 'gitleaks'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\node.exe", "*\\bun.exe") Image IN ("*trufflehog.exe", "*gitleaks.exe") OR CommandLine IN ("*trufflehog*", "*gitleaks*")
